title: Evaluation limited to text tasks (translation and parsing)
description: The Transformer is only evaluated on text tasks (machine translation and English constituency parsing). The authors explicitly state plans to extend to other modalities.
canonical_description: evaluation limited to text tasks, extension to other modalities planned

evidence.anchor: extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text
evidence.quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
